mechanism_finding: The positive paired advantage does NOT come from the registered mechanism (selective abstention), which is net-NEGATIVE here (-297c: missed more profitable T0 trades than losses avoided). It comes from an INCIDENTAL second effect: T1 enters the first DISAGREEMENT-eligible row, which differs from T0's first-eligible row, shifting entry timing/price (+1007c, concentrated in ~5 windows). So frozen T1 differs from T0 in TWO ways (abstention AND entry-row selection) — an experiment-integrity note for PROSPECTIVE-T0-vs-T1 (§10 treatment purity). NOT retuned per directive; flagged for the owner.
note: estimand base = in-envelope eligible windows; T1 abstention -> P&L 0, window retained. Frozen policies; no retuning. OFFLINE holdout — prospective evidence still required to establish the effect.
